fixes.title: accepting a rejected phase leaves a stale blocker, which then outlives the milestone
ac phase add --milestone N repoints the project's active milestone
execute-phase dispatches dependents of a blocked task
/astro-execute clears the live activity on an early stop even when it stopped because a workflow is already running, and a resumed workflow never sets the activity again

Hook registrations can point at scripts the installed copy doesn't have: settings.json lists astro-principles.mjs 2/4..4/4 while ~/.astro/code is still 0.38.0, so every session start logs 3 'SessionStart:startup hook error' (MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
Questions put to the user (discuss, accept, challenge…) start from a low-level detail with no context, so the user can't tell what part of the system they're about or why the choice matters
a decisions-collision refusal prints a malformed empty fix list: 'Fix: .'
ac backlog list says "oldest first" but sorts by id, so same-day captures list out of capture order
ac install uses symlinkSync with no copy fallback, so a standard Windows user gets EPERM
canon pull silently deletes hand-written non-ADR prose from DECISIONS.md and reports plain success
The statusline hook crashes with an unhandled EPIPE when its stdout reader closes early
